items.markdown:
![Victorian corsets: What they were like & how women used to ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09080743-1621-0139-0000-1295cf746312:4)
A corset is `a close-fitting foundation garment worn to shape, support, and constrict the torso`.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corset) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corset)

### Definition and Design

- **Structure:** Traditional corsets use stiff vertical panels (called a busk) and flexible boning made from steel or rigid materials to hold the torso upright.
- **Lacing:** Back or front lacing lets the wearer pull the garment tight to shape the waist, ribs, and hips.
- **History:** They served as essential undergarments in Western fashion from the 17th century through the early 20th century.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTpjRDIhlbM&t=109) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTpjRDIhlbM&t=109)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corset)

### Modern Types

- **Overbust:** Covers the chest and torso completely, often styled as a top.
- **Underbust:** Sits just under the bustline down to the hips, worn over shirts or dresses.
- **Waspie:** A wide belt-style corset focused strictly on cinching the waist.
- **Corset Tops:** Ready-to-wear outer garments that mimic the structured look of traditional corsets without heavy medical-grade or tight-lacing compression.[](https://princesspolly.co.uk/collections/corsets-bustiers) [[1]](https://princesspolly.co.uk/collections/corsets-bustiers)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Yre-7ytPrJM)

If you are looking to buy or style a corset, tell me:

- Are you looking for an **undergarment, a casual top, or historical wear**?
- Do you have a specific **budget or preferred style**?
